title: Retire and correction handling for announcements
description:
Part of the scheduled publishing and announcements epic. Design: docs/plans/scheduled-publishing-and-announcements.md ("Retirement and corrections").

Goal: a retired Story's announcement is removed from X; a correction leaves the post (its link shows the corrected page); an editor can withdraw a post whose own text became wrong.

Shape: `story_retire.py` retirement deletes the post through the channel (price recorded) and marks the announcement `withdrawn: Story retired`; a scheduled retired Story loses its schedule (scheduling story); "Withdraw announcement" in the drawer and the operation table; no automatic new announcement for the same Story. X API edit is out of scope until its eligibility rules are verified.

Depends on: the channel framework story.

```gherkin
Feature: An announcement follows its Story when the Story is retired or corrected
  We must never leave a post on X pointing readers at something we took back.

  Scenario: Retiring a Story deletes its post
    Given an announced Article
    When an editor retires it with a redirect
    Then its post is deleted from X
    And the announcement says "Withdrawn: Story retired"

  Scenario: A correction keeps the post
    Given an announced Article
    When a corrected version is published with a revision note
    Then the post stays
    And its link shows the corrected page

  Scenario: Withdrawing a post whose text is wrong
    Given the post repeats a claim the correction removed
    When Sam chooses "Withdraw announcement"
    Then the post is deleted and recorded as withdrawn by Sam

  Scenario: A failed delete is visible
    Given X refuses to delete the post
    Then the announcement shows "Delete failed" with X's message and a retry button
```

Open questions: none.
